# Bundled browser dependencies

These files are served locally by GitHub Pages; no third-party CDN is used at runtime.

- gif.js 0.2.0 (`gif.js`, `gif.worker.js`), MIT; https://github.com/jnordberg/gif.js
- PDF.js / pdfjs-dist 4.10.38 (`pdf.mjs`, `pdf.worker.mjs`, `cmaps`, `standard_fonts`), Apache-2.0; https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
- fflate 0.8.2 (`fflate.js`), MIT; https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate

Distributed JavaScript and font/CMap files were copied from those exact npm package releases. See the adjacent licenses and the font/CMap license files in their respective directories. gif.js's MIT license was obtained from its upstream repository because the npm tarball omits it.
